title: Travel Nurse vs. Staff Nurse Comp
description: Net-pay comparison of travel nursing against a permanent staff post, ported from ApexLogics Apex #132. Stacks a caller-asserted tax-free housing stipend and M&IE allowance against contract gap weeks, travel cost and out-of-pocket housing; reports staff net ex benefits, travel net, the annual delta, stipend tax savings and the effective all-in hourly rate. NOT TAX ADVICE: stipend excludability is a caller assumption. A 0 or blank input reverts to the tool default and each substitution is named.

staffHours.description: Staff hours worked per week. staffGrossAnnual = staffRate x staffHours x staffWeeks. page default 36; 0 reverts to the default.

staffBenefits.description: Annual value of the staff benefits package, USD/yr.

staffWeeks.description: Weeks worked per year on the staff post. page default 50; 0 reverts to the default.

taxRate.description: Assumed effective tax rate expressed as a PERCENT.

travelBase.description: Taxable hourly base rate on the travel contract, USD/hr.

housingStipend.description: Weekly housing stipend, USD/week, ASSUMED tax-free.

mieStipend.description: Weekly meals and incidental expenses allowance, USD/week, ASSUMED tax-free.

travelHours.description: Hours worked per week on travel.

travelCost.description: Travel and moving cost per contract, USD.

input_schema.x_apexport_required_note: required is empty on purpose. All fourteen inputs are unconditionally dereferenced by the compute, but none of them is mandatory: every one has a defined page default, and the default-substitution path is itself load-bearing behaviour under test (boundary pairs B01-B14). Requiring all fourteen would make both the default path and the zero-swallow unreachable through the schema and would silently change the ported tool. A caller that wants the Apex defaults sends {} or null. Flagged for the trusted builder as OPEN-1 in APEXPORT-132-REPORT.md.

staffRate.description: The RESOLVED value. If the input was 0, blank or non-numeric this is the page default, not the supplied number.

taxRate.description: The RESOLVED rate as a fraction, not a percent.

stipendTaxSavings.description: A counterfactual on an ASSERTED treatment: what the stipends would have cost had they been taxed at taxRate. Not a tax computation.

gapCost.description: Opportunity cost of the unpaid gap weeks, priced at the STAFF hourly rate.

effectiveHourly.description: travelNetAnnual / totalHoursWorked when totalHoursWorked > 0, else the literal 0.

totalAnnualGapWeeks.description: gapWeeks x contractsPerYear. Page local; not in the page's own _lastResult.

totalHoursWorked.description: travelHours x weeksWorked. Page local; not in the page's own _lastResult.

travelWins.description: travelNetAnnual > staffNetNoFringe, STRICT. An exact tie reports travel as the loser.
